scope: S5 durable audit/outbox lifecycle on exclusive disposable PostgreSQL and MinIO using the declared fixture adapter. The proof reads authorized runtime projections and private audit/outbox pages; it does not claim public HTTP, a protected sandbox, Firecracker, Linux/KVM, or EX-002.

observations.authorization_chain: The persisted append-only audit chain covers pending approval, approval, denial, expiry, revocation, cancellation, grant consumption, execution intent, terminal result, and exhaustion in checked durable order.
observations.correlation: Each checked lifecycle phase links its audit fact to the durable outbox route and operation correlation. The explicit terminal approval and post-approval finalization product events also link to their audit facts; audit facts retain actor and tenant identity, agent/policy commitments, capability-scope digest, tool-call correlation, and bounded timestamps.
observations.privacy_and_access: Owner scope cannot enumerate the private audit or outbox pages, and assertions reject descriptor, input, credential-shaped, and raw output leakage.

redaction: No DSNs, object-store credentials, raw audit IDs, operation IDs, descriptors, inputs, artifact bodies, output bodies, or backend endpoints are retained.
